item.title: Best Mountain & Defensive Seeds in RimWorld (1.6 & Odyssey)
item.description: Mountain seeds are great for defense-minded players. Build your base inside or against a mountain for natural choke points against raids. Use these with the current 1.6 / Odyssey version. Top Mountain Seeds SeedMap typeNotes bedrock30% coverageStrong mountain backing, single entrance defense. fortress30% coverageDeep mountain, huge interior building space. gatekeeper20% coverageTight valley, easy to wall off. Why a Mountain Base Wins Mountain bases need fewer walls, absorb raids at choke points, and protect against orbital events.
